facts.text: I have a friend who is getting out of a long sentence for charges.
My friend went to federal hands.
My friend’s electronic communication will be monitored.
I have a relationship with my friend where we make a lot of jokes and use extreme sarcasm.
I occasionally talk with my friend about sports wagers.
I am worried that our jokes or messages could be taken the wrong way by people looking at my friend’s phone.
I want a disclaimer message that I can send via text message when communication opens up again.
I want the disclaimer to protect me legally from anything that could come up in the future.
I want to be able to fall back on the disclaimer message if a joke or message is taken the wrong way by a third party.
The disclaimer will be sent to my friend.
I want the disclaimer to be somewhat clever and not inherently obvious as a legal disclaimer.

events.text: Friend is getting out of a long sentence for charges
Communication will resume after release and will be monitored electronically
